caption:
"How did the talk go?" "You remembered!" Following up is half of paying attention.

Asking about what someone mentioned once shows you were listening the first time.

For whoever asks how the thing they mentioned went.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway with a door on the left. A ink-black block figure with white eyes waits in the middle while a royal blue figure walks in from the right. A bubble says how did the talk go? The blue one opens its eyes wide and a bubble says you remembered! Its eyes turn happy and then the black one's do too. The text stays: me remembering to ask.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
